benchmark.comparability: Same evaluation dates and base costs; strategy cannot first signal before Jan1 close, whereas control is intentionally signaled at Dec31 close.
benchmark.execution: First evaluation open 2023-01-01, lag1, fee8bps and slip2bps per side; same fixed-quantity cash rejection policy.
benchmark.fee_control_limitation: Only one base 8 bps fee / 2 bps slippage buy-and-hold control. No independently matched fee0, fee20, or delay2 control was run; those cases are strategy-only sensitivities.
benchmark.holding: No rebalance or sale; residual cash after fill need not equal 10%; exposure weight need not remain 90%.
benchmark.if_rejected: Remain cash for entire window; no retry.
benchmark.name: buyhold-base
benchmark.sizing: Unconditional signal at last warmup close 2022-12-31: q=0.9*100000/close; frozen quantity.

entry.frozen: Freeze q, signal index, due index and signal-close high seed at signal; never resize or recompute at fill.
entry.when: flat and EMA20 > close > EMA50 > EMA100; every inequality strict

execution.buy_cash: principal=q*buy_price; fee=principal*fee_rate; required=principal+fee; accept iff required<=cash; subtract that same required once.
execution.decimal_operation_order: All intermediates Decimal50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN; do not regroup cash expressions.
execution.event_order: At most one existing intent executed or rejected per open; then update completed-close indicators and held exit or flat entry. No same-open round trip.
execution.pending: Earliest BUY or SELL remains latched until due open. Disappearing raw entry does not cancel BUY; recovering price does not cancel SELL. Repeats never postpone.
execution.rejection: Insufficient cash: no fill, no fee, no clip/epsilon/resize; clear only that intent; preserve cash; a qualifying later close may create a new order.
execution.terminal: Mark final raw close without forced sale or fee; retain out-of-window pending intent without consuming another bar.

exit.high: Store signal-close seed in BUY intent. Flat pending closes do not raise it. Activate only on actual BUY, then update using completed held closes.
exit.predicate: After high=max(high,close): close<=EMA50 OR close<Decimal(0.95)*high. Exactly 0.95*high is not a high-drawdown exit by itself.
exit.priority: At completed close, held exit branch precedes flat entry branch; a flat downtrend guard cannot suppress held exit.
exit.reset: Clear high only on actual sale; do not seed it from raw or slipped fill open; no intrabar high/low trigger.

indicators.seed: At n-th selected close, left-to-right sum of first n selected closes divided by Decimal(n).
indicators.warmup: Use exactly 100 preceding complete closes; no earlier raw rows, no fills, no inherited strategy intent.
